submission.justification: Absorber-F3 at 4mm plate thickness delivers the best energy resolution of 3.169% at 100 GeV, significantly outperforming F2 (3.845% at 6mm) and F1 (5.033% at 6mm). The resolution shows an optimal point at 4mm, degrading at both smaller (2mm: 3.753%) and larger thicknesses (6mm: 3.191%, 8mm: 3.684%, 10mm: 4.657%). This configuration best meets the primary goal of achieving the best possible energy resolution. Note: Dose rate data was not available in the simulation results to verify compliance with the 20 μSv/h constraint; this should be confirmed through additional radiation physics calculations or measurements before final implementation.
